meta.positioning: Real 2025+ foreign buy-side demand for this Iran-sourced product (verified + de-noised).
meta.note: Moderate for cumin, thin for thyme, thin for Damask rose. Genuine 2025-2026 foreign buy-side demand really exists for cumin — recurring, dated RFQs concentrated in the Gulf (UAE/Oman, several origin-agnostic so Iran-eligible) plus a few Latin American leads (Mexico, Chile) — but it lives almost entirely behind login-gated B2B directories (TradeKey/Freshdi) and often specs the Indian 'Singapore 99' grade. Thyme shows just one credible 2025 lead (Colombia, thyme within a mixed-herb order). Damask rose oil/rose water demand is thin and unverifiable: only weak, recycled directory listings with auto-bumped 'updated' timestamps, none solid enough to keep.
